mechanism.plausibility_rationale: Adenosine is primarily used for its rapid-acting, short-lived effects on the AV node and coronary vasculature. It is rapidly metabolized by adenosine deaminase in the blood and tissues, resulting in a half-life of less than 10 seconds. Because of this extremely short duration of action and its lack of direct nephrotoxic mechanisms, it is not considered a standard cause of acute kidney injury.
